summary:
Business initiatives thrive on the strength of a capable team, including those in data & analytics. Skilled CDAOs focus on attracting top talent and cultivating an environment that encourages long term engagement and retention.

Hosted by Steffen lange at Dormakaba International Holding AG, join this session to discuss:

Planning strategically for your current and future talent needs
Understanding the skill needs of each function within the data organization
Building teams with diversity and a plan for growth

Join these Peer Meetups, powered by Gartner CDAO Communities, for a networking session that allows you to connect and share with a small group of your peers facilitated by a CDAO Community Member. Please make every effort to attend as other attendees will be looking forward to meeting with you.
